description: This file implements the SecureSocketPort class and its nested Handler class, providing SSL/TLS socket handling using OpenSSL. It includes initialization, read/write, shutdown, and handshake management functionalities for secure communication.

classes.name: OpenSSL
classes.description: A helper class for initializing OpenSSL library functions, ensuring they are called once.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: A nested class within SecureSocketPort that manages SSL/TLS connection lifecycle, including handshake, read/write, and shutdown.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::~Handler
methods.description: Destructor that frees SSL and SSL_CTX resources if they are allocated.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes SSL context and SSL object, sets up the connection, and enables SNI if a hostname is provided.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the SSL connection into the provided buffer.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the SSL connection from the provided buffer.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Close
methods.description: Shuts down the SSL connection and closes the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Update
methods.description: Manages the SSL handshake process, progressing through states and updating connection status.
